text:
Sam: quick note — trying to get the JS SDK sample app running under Deno/Bun for the new onboarding tutorial and running into three separate DX problems: module resolution (ESM vs CJS), fetch differences (streaming + retries), and web-crypto typings. anyone else seen this? :thinking:

Maya: yup saw similar on my machine. Deno rejects the package.json "exports" entry unless we ship an explicit ESM entrypoint. error was `Invalid module specifier` when importing from `@redwood/inference` in a bare import.

Jorge: Bun's resolver is more forgiving but it rewrites `node:` shims differently. We also got runtime crash in Bun edge because a small helper used `Buffer.from` which isn't present in the default edge environment.

Sam: example import that fails in Deno:```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
```
works in node with CJS compat, fails in Deno unless you point to `/dist/esm/index.js` or use an import_map.

Toni: workaround that worked for me in Deno (not ideal): add import_map.json ->
```json
{
  "imports": { "@redwood/inference": "./node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js" }
}
```
then run `deno run --import-map=import_map.json`. But that leaks build details to the consumer sample.

Maya: another painful one: the SDK expects `globalThis.crypto.subtle` typings (web crypto) for signature verification. Deno has `crypto.subtle` but the TS types don't line up with our `node-webcrypto` typedefs, so consumers see type errors in strictly typed TS projects.

Jorge: And fetch behavior — our retry logic wraps `fetch` and expects `response.body.getReader()` for streaming cancellation. In Bun, `response.body` implementation differs and `getReader()` is missing, so retries/abort behave differently. Caused the sample app to hang when streaming embeddings.

Sam: TL;DR: three asks coming out of the sample app test: 1) publish an ESM-first entrypoint (deno-friendly), 2) provide a small edge-compatible shim bundle (no Buffer, no node:crypto), 3) ship narrower web-crypto typings or a types package targeting Deno.

Toni: +1. Also think we should document recommended import patterns for Deno/Bun in the quickstart (small section titled "Edge & Deno/Bun notes") so onboarding folks don't hit the same friction.

Maya: created a draft PR for docs in the onboarding repo, linking to ticket DX-432. PR includes a short snippet for import_map + Bun import example.

devex-bot: New issue created: DX-432: "Deno/Bun: ESM entrypoint, edge shims, and web-crypto typing compatibility" — https://redwood/issue/DX-432 :white_check_mark:

Sam: for implementation guidance — we could publish a tiny `@redwood/inference-deno` package that re-exports the ESM bundle and ships a deno-specific types file. That would keep main package backwards compatible. Thoughts?

Jorge: that seems sensible. Another option: set `exports` field in package.json to include `./deno` -> `./dist/deno/index.mjs` so consumers can `import '@redwood/inference/deno'`. Cleaner than separate package.

Toni: either way, we need CI that builds a deno-targeted artifact and runs quick sanity checks in Deno/Bun. Right now our CI only runs node.

Maya: I'll add a CI job to run `deno run` against the sample app and a tiny Bun script. If we add a deno bundle, CI can ensure `import` resolves and a basic request/stream works.

Sam: Great. For now I'll update the sample app readme with the import_map workaround + a Bun note that you may need `globalThis.Buffer = Buffer` polyfill in non-edge Bun. Will paste the small code snippet here once done.

Toni: thanks — ping me when PRs are up, I can take the packaging change. :rocket:

Sam: thanks all, will follow up in DX-432 with artifacts and a short checklist.
